summary: The fix-range classification ignores the range's own gate class (only errors and runtimeLines are used), so a fix commit that edits a gate path (e.g. putting a .github/workflows file back to base) still plans NEXT: scoped unless the agent separately passes --touched-gate, contrary to the documented rule that a gate-touching fix keeps the full pass 2.
evidence: bin/gstack-review-plan:104-105 `const range = classifyDiff({...collectCommit(root, resolved, 'HEAD'), registry, gateTagged: 0}); fixRange = range.errors.length ? unread(...) : { base: rangeBase, runtime_lines: range.runtimeLines };` — range.class is dropped. Scratch repo: branch adds 80-line src/a.ts and edits .github/workflows/ci.yml; fix commit puts ci.yml back to base and adds 1 line; `gstack-review-plan --base main --gate-tagged 0 --pass 1 --last full --fixed-blocking --adversarial-ran --range-base <sha>` printed `FIX_RANGE: runtime_lines=3` and `NEXT: scoped (a blocking finding was fixed on a standard diff with 3 runtime lines in the fix range (<= 150): scoped pass on the range)`.

summary: The CLI classifies the fix range but keeps only its runtime line count and ignores its class. A fix commit that touches a gate (e.g. deletes a test the branch added) still gets a scoped pass 2 unless the agent also passes --touched-gate, though docs/review-policy.md says such a fix keeps the full pass 2. The whole-branch check misses it when the fix brings the path back to how it is on main.
evidence: Line 70: `const range = classifyDiff({ ...collectCommit(root, resolved, 'HEAD'), registry, gateTagged: 0 }); fixRange = range.errors.length ? unread(...) : { base: rangeBase, runtime_lines: range.runtimeLines };` (range.class unused). Scratch repo: the branch adds src/a.ts (80 lines) and test/a.test.ts; the fix commit runs `git rm test/a.test.ts` and adds src/fix.ts (10 lines). `gstack-review-plan --base main --gate-tagged 0 --pass 1 --last full --fixed-blocking --adversarial-ran --range-base <pre-fix sha>` printed `NEXT: scoped (... 10 runtime lines in the fix range (<= 150) ...)`, while classifyDiff on the same range returned `gate ["code: src/fix.ts", "deletes 1 code or test path(s)"] 10`.
